profile_bio: I specialize in anxiety, depression, and life transitions using evidence-based approaches including CBT and mindfulness.
profile_approach: I use a collaborative, client-centered approach drawing from CBT, mindfulness-based therapy, and solution-focused techniques. I believe in creating a safe space where clients can explore challenges and develop practical coping strategies.
profile_areas_of_focus: I work with adults experiencing anxiety, depression, life transitions, and relationship issues. I have particular experience supporting clients through career changes, grief, and major life adjustments.
profile_journey: My path to therapy began with my own experience navigating major life transitions. That journey inspired me to help others find clarity and resilience during challenging times.
profile_goals_for_clients: My goal is to help each client build insight, develop practical skills, and find their own path forward. I measure success by the changes clients experience in their daily lives.
profile_first_session: In our first session, we will explore what brings you to therapy, your goals, and what you hope to achieve. I will explain my approach and we will determine if we are a good fit together.
